general.summary:
On October 21, 2026, Node.js announced the availability of fixes for multiple vulnerabilities across the following supported release lines: 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x. These vulnerabilities impact critical operations such as the Brotli decoder, DNS resolution, and TLS certificate validation. The vulnerabilities pose risks for remote code execution and traffic interception. For more information, see Node.js Security Release . The following vulnerabilities have a Security Impact Rating (SIR) of High and are addressed in this advisory: CVE-2026-111497 - Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write; potential remote code execution CVE-2026-105482 - DNS resolution truncation involving embedded NUL characters CVE-2026-105483 - TLS hostname validation bypass using fullwidth IP digits CVE-2026-106069 - TLS hostname validation bypass with noncanonical IP addresses For information about Splunk products and offerings, see Vulnerabilities in Node.js (CVE-2026-111497, CVE-2026-105482, CVE-2026-105483, CVE-2026-106069) on Splunk Products - October 2026 Important: If a product is not listed within this advisory, Cisco's review indicates that the product is not affected by this vulnerability. This advisory will be updated as additional information becomes available. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-oct2026-node-js-Jj3SQ19u
Security Impact Rating: High
general.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026

general.summary:
A vulnerability in the Remote Access SSL VPN service of Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Cisco Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition. This vulnerability is due to logic errors when secondary authentication is configured on a tunnel group. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted request when connecting to the SSL remote access VPN. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the affected device to reload, resulting in a DoS condition. Cisco has released software updates that address this vulnerability. There are no workarounds that address this vulnerability. This advisory is available at the following link: https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-asaftd-tunnel-dos-s6mgkb75
Security Impact Rating: High
CVE: CVE-2026-76418
general.title: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance and Secure Firewall Threat Defense Software Remote Access SSL VPN Tunnel Denial of Service Vulnerability
